pairs: the sons of Israel consulted the Lord, saying,
dicentes: Quis ascendet ante nos contra Chananæum,
“Who will ascend before us, against the Canaanite,
and who will be the commander of the war?”
ecce tradidi terram in manus ejus.
Behold, I have delivered the land into his hands.”
Et ait Judas Simeoni fratri suo:
And Judah said to his brother Simeon,
“Go up with me to my lot,
ut et ego pergam tecum in sortem tuam.
so that I also may go forth with you to your lot.”
et tradidit Dominus Chananæum ac Pherezæum in manus eorum:
and the Lord delivered the Canaanite, as well as the Perizzite, into their hands.
et percusserunt in Bezec decem millia virorum.
And they struck down ten thousand of the men at Bezek.
And they found Adonibezek at Bezek,
and they struck down the Canaanite and the Perizzite.
And they pursued him and captured him,
cæsis summitatibus manuum ejus ac pedum.
and they cut off the ends of his hands and feet.
Septuaginta reges amputatis manuum ac pedum summitatibus colligebant sub mensa mea ciborum reliquias:
“Seventy kings, with the ends of their hands and feet amputated, have been gathering the remnants of food under my table.
sicut feci, ita reddidit mihi Deus.
Just as I have done, so has God repaid me.”
And they brought him to Jerusalem,
Then the sons of Judah, besieging Jerusalem,
ceperunt eam, et percusserunt in ore gladii,
seized it. And they struck it with edge of the sword,
delivering the entire city to be burned.
Et postea descendentes pugnaverunt contra Chananæum,
they fought against the Canaanites who were living in the mountains,
qui habitabat in Hebron (cujus nomen fuit antiquitus Cariath Arbe),
going forth against the Canaanites who were living at Hebron,
(the name of which from antiquity was Kiriath-Arba) struck down Sheshai,
atque inde profectus abiit ad habitatores Dabir,
And continuing on from there, he went to the inhabitants of Debir,
cujus nomen vetus erat Cariath Sepher,
the old name of which was Kiriath-Sepher,
and will lay waste to it,
dabo ei Axam filiam meam uxorem.
I will give to him my daughter Achsah as wife.”
Cumque cepisset eam Othoniel filius Cenez frater Caleb minor,
And when Othniel, the son of Kenaz, a younger brother of Caleb,
dedit ei Axam filiam suam conjugem.
had seized it, he gave his daughter Achsah to him in marriage.
Quam pergentem in itinere monuit vir suus ut peteret a patre suo agrum.
And as she was traveling on a journey, her husband admonished her, so that she would request a field from her father.
Quæ cum suspirasset sedens in asino,
And since she had sighed while sitting on her donkey,
For you have given me a dry land.
Dedit ergo ei Caleb irriguum superius,
Caleb gave to her the upper watered land and the lower watered land.
Filii autem Cinæi cognati Moysi ascenderunt de civitate palmarum cum filiis Juda,
Now the sons of the Kenite, the relative of Moses, ascended from the City of Palms,
with the sons of Judah, into the wilderness of his lot,
which is toward the south of Arad.
Abiit autem Judas cum Simeone fratre suo,
Then Judah went out with his brother Simeon,
et percusserunt simul Chananæum qui habitabat in Sephaath,
and together they struck the Canaanites who were living at Zephath,
and they put them to death.
And the name of the city was called Hormah,
Cepitque Judas Gazam cum finibus suis,
And Judah seized Gaza, with its parts,
et Ascalonem, atque Accaron cum terminis suis.
and Ashkelon as well as Ekron, with their borders.
And the Lord was with Judah,
But he was not able to wipe out the inhabitants of the valley.
For they abounded with chariots armed with scythes.
And just as Moses had said,
qui delevit ex ea tres filios Enac.
who destroyed out of it the three sons of Anak.
Jebusæum autem habitatorem Jerusalem non deleverunt filii Benjamin:
But the sons of Benjamin did not wipe out the Jebusite inhabitants of Jerusalem.
habitavitque Jebusæus cum filiis Benjamin in Jerusalem,
And the Jebusite has lived with the sons of Benjamin in Jerusalem,
Domus quoque Joseph ascendit in Bethel,
The house of Joseph also ascended against Bethel,
and the Lord was with them.
For when they were besieging the city,
they saw a man departing from the city,
“Reveal to us the entrance to the city,
and we will act with mercy toward you.”
And when he had revealed it to them,
they struck the city with the edge of the sword.
abiit in terram Hetthim, et ædificavit ibi civitatem,
he went out to the land of the Hittites, and he built a city there,
quæ ita appellatur usque in præsentem diem.
And so it is called, even to the present day.
Manasseh did not destroy Bethshean and Taanach,
nor the inhabitants of Dor and Ibleam and Megiddo,
And the Canaanite began to live with them.
Then, after Israel had grown strong, he made them tributaries,
fecit eos tributarios, et delere noluit.
but he was not willing to destroy them.
And now Ephraim did not put to death the Canaanite,
Zabulon non delevit habitatores Cetron, et Naalol:
Zebulun did not wipe out the inhabitants of Kitron and of Nahalal.
sed habitavit Chananæus in medio ejus, factusque est ei tributarius.
Instead, the Canaanite lived in their midst and became their tributary.
Aser quoque non delevit habitatores Accho, et Sidonis,
Likewise, Asher did not destroy the inhabitants of Acco and Sidon,
habitavitque in medio Chananæi habitatoris illius terræ,
And he lived in the midst of the Canaanites, the inhabitants of that land,
for he did not put them to death.
Nephthali quoque non delevit habitatores Bethsames, et Bethanath:
Naphtali also did not wipe out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Bethanath.
et habitavit inter Chananæum habitatorem terræ,
And he lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land.
fueruntque ei Bethsamitæ et Bethanitæ tributarii.
And the Beth-shemeshites and Bethanathites were tributaries to him.
Arctavitque Amorrhæus filios Dan in monte,
And the Amorite hemmed in the sons of Dan on the mountain,
nec dedit eis locum ut ad planiora descenderent:
and did not give them a place, so that they might descend to the flatlands.
And he lived on the mountain at Har-heres,
Et aggravata est manus domus Joseph,
But the hand of the house of Joseph was very heavy,
and he became a tributary to him.
Fuit autem terminus Amorrhæi ab ascensu Scorpionis,
